text: dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch 是供 DSH 网页端使用的 Elasticsearch 日志检索插件。它通过网页设置面板保存集群 URI 和可选的基本认证信息，并在主机侧注册 es_query_logs 工具及自动使用提示。用户可以按 trace_id 精确查找，也可以用关键词搜索日志内容，还能限定索引、字段和返回数量。适合需要从 DSH 会话中排查请求日志或错误的开发者；使用前需配置可访问的 Elasticsearch 集群。

dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch adds Elasticsearch log search to DSH web. Configure cluster URIs and optional basic authentication, then use es_query_logs to search by trace ID or text terms and limit results by index, fields, or count. It helps developers investigate request logs and errors.
想按请求的 trace_id 查一下 Elasticsearch 里的日志。
帮我从日志内容里找出包含连接失败或异常信息的记录。
Find Elasticsearch log entries matching a trace ID or error keywords.
dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch 的功能「检索日志」：es_query_logs 按 trace_id 或关键词搜索 Elasticsearch 日志，支持指定索引、字段和返回数量，并输出匹配文档。
dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch 的功能「配置连接」：在 DSH 网页的 Elasticsearch 设置页填写多个 URI、用户名和密码，保存到共享设置中，供日志查询工具复用。
日志查询会把搜索条件发送到配置的 Elasticsearch URI，并将配置的用户名和密码用于基本认证；请确认集群地址和认证信息符合你的使用要求。

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch：- **Settings → Elasticsearch**: configure `uris` (one per line), `username`, and
  `password`. Values are stored in the shared DSH settings document and shared
  across sessions.
- **`es_query_logs` tool**: search logs by `trace_id` (exact match) and/or by
  natural-language search terms via `query` (matched against `message`,
  `exception`, and other log text fields), with optional `fields`, `index`, and
  `size`. It reuses the connection configured above.
- **Auto-guidance**: a system-prompt section teaches every session to use the
  tool when a `trace_id` or a log-content question is asked — no dedicated
  agent preset required.

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch@latest
```

Then restart the deployment. The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so
`dsh plugin` registers it as a profile bundle automatically.

> Requires pnpm on `PATH`. The plugin resolves its `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime
> dependencies as peer dependencies from the DSH installation, so it shares the
> installation's single Cordis instance.

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · Tool：| name       | type             | required | default | notes                                  |
| ---------- | ---------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `query`    | string           | no*      | —       | natural-language search terms matched against log text fields (e.g. `"connection refused"`, `"NullPointerException"`) |
| `trace_id` | string           | no*      | —       | exact trace id to search across trace fields |
| `fields`   | string[]         | no       | common log text fields | explicit fields the `query` matches against; wildcards unsupported |
| `index`    | string           | no       | `*`     | index pattern to target                |
| `size`     | integer          | no       | `100`   | max hits, capped at 500                |

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · Tool：\* at least one of `query` or `trace_id` is required.

- `trace_id` runs exact `term` queries on `trace_id`, `trace.id`, `traceId`,
  and `traceID`.
- `query` runs a `multi_match` (best_fields) over the resolved fields, avoiding
  wildcard field expansion that fails on wide indices.
- Both together narrow by trace and content; results are sorted by
  `@timestamp` desc, trying each configured URI in order.

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · Development：The compiled `lib/` ships with this repo, so consumers can install from the
directory directly. Building from source requires the
[deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) monorepo:
`tsdown.config.ts` imports the `clientBundle` preset from
`packages/client/tsdown.client.ts`. The published npm package
(`@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch`) is the canonical build artifact.

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · Future Plans：**Current boundary.** Today the agent correlates logs only against the local
workspace. Code-side integration stays on hold until DSH officially exposes a
remote/network workspace (e.g. binding `0.0.0.0`) — correlating logs against a
workspace the agent cannot reach would be meaningless.

@asuka1121/dsh-client-ui-elasticsearch README · Future Plans：**Open problem — acquiring the code.** The leading idea is to clone the owning
project on the **server side**, on demand, before each query, keyed by the
`app_name` found in the logs, so answers stay self-contained and always based
on the latest code. Storing full clones for every app is expensive, so lighter
approaches are under evaluation: shallow/partial clones, lazily fetching only
the files a trace references, and cache/eviction policies.
